'''Mowan Mowadon''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==Biography==
While on a supply mission to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], he was the only survivor of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack on a convoy of [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. He testified for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] what he had seen and described the [[Blazing Claw/Legends|Blazing Claw]] symbol on the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|Marauder ships]]. The speech was translated by a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].
